tldr: Venus through the 6th house brings focus to work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance.
body: Venus transiting the 6th house softens work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports daily systems and practical support: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or overwork or neglecting the body.
advice: Receive and refine in the 6th house deliberately. Work with work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
